prompt: Each interior angle of a certain regular polygon measures 140°. What is the sum of the measures of all the interior angles of this polygon?
A cylindrical tank has a radius of 6 feet and a height of 10 feet. What is the lateral surface area of the tank — the curved side only, not the two circular ends — in square feet, in terms of π?
In right triangle ABC, the right angle is at C, AB = 25, and BC = 7. What is the value of cos A?
An equilateral triangle has sides of length 12 centimeters. What is the height of the triangle, in centimeters, to the nearest tenth?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, the graph of x² + y² − 4x + 10y = 20 is a circle. What is the radius of this circle?
A closed rectangular box measures 5 inches by 8 inches by 3 inches. What is the total surface area of the box, in square inches?

A square pane of glass measures 14 inches on each side. A quarter circle of radius 14 inches, centered at one corner of the square, is cut out and removed. Using 22/7 for π, what is the area of the piece that remains, in square inches?

prompt: A basketball player scored 82, 91, 76, 88, and 93 points in five games. What was the mean number of points she scored per game?
Six students reported the number of books they read last month: 12, 7, 15, 9, 7, and 20. What is the median of these six numbers?
A bag contains 4 red marbles, 7 blue marbles, and 9 green marbles. One marble is drawn at random. What is the probability that the marble drawn is blue, to the nearest hundredth?
A drawer contains 5 black socks and 3 white socks. Two socks are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both socks drawn are black?
A shop sold 15 shirts at an average price of $76 and 5 jackets at an average price of $96. What was the average price, in dollars, of the 20 items sold?
A sandwich shop offers 4 kinds of bread, 6 fillings, and 5 sauces. How many different sandwiches can be made using exactly one bread, one filling, and one sauce?
A committee of 3 people is to be chosen from a group of 8 people. How many different committees are possible?
